title: Teriyaki Shrimp Nigiri
description: Butterflied cooked shrimp glazed with teriyaki over seasoned rice ovals.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Peel, devein and butterfly shrimp along the belly without splitting them completely. Straighten gently.
Cook shrimp through until fully opaque. Add teriyaki and reduce briefly to coat; allow to cool slightly.
Form approximately 24 rice ovals, each close to 25 g. Drape each with one cooked shrimp.
Brush with any remaining glaze and sprinkle a few sesame seeds.
notes: Use enough shrimp pieces to top the 24 nigiri; if shrimp are unusually small, use two per nigiri.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
Cook shrimp thoroughly until the flesh is opaque throughout.
